$comment: Canonical enum values, hand-synced from backend/app/database/models/*.py (the single source of truth). There is no cross-language codegen wired up in this project — Dart (apps/mobile), TypeScript-as-documentation (shared/types), and the JS apps (apps/web, admin/dashboard) each reference these values directly rather than importing a generated client, so this file exists to make 'hand-synced' something that can actually be diffed against the backend source instead of drifting silently. If you change an enum in backend/app/database/models/, update this file in the same change.
